attempts.summary: Configured node1 so only root and opsadmin can use crontab. The missing opsadmin account was created with a locked password and no wheel/SSH access. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing mode, and existing cron data were preserved. The policy and crond recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
